t_advice_summary_textbox.text: the different coloured baskets link to the colours of the gnomes. green, blue, yellow and orange link in one group. Pink, red, brown and ? in the other. once you receive 0 points with one selection swap the groups to the other basket colour

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 colours of gnome, two sets of 4 which each belong to 2 coloured basket. A yellow or red basket. The yellow basket belongs to the yellow, green, blue and orange gnomes (the brighter ones) and the red basket belongs to the red, brown, purple and pink gnomes (darker ones). When your score starts to drop low, around 3 mushrooms, swap to the other colour group of gnomes to increase the number of mushrooms collected. I found that the quicker you clicked the space bar the higher the chance of receiving more mushrooms.
